Handles protocol-relative URLs (//example.com) correctly

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::scrape;
use crawlberg::create_engine;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine = create_engine(None).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let result = scrape(&engine, &url).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.links.len());
    println!("{:?}", result.links[0].url);
}
```
